strategy.name: Aggressive Momentum — Quality (Paper)
strategy.desc: Concentrated swing trades in liquid large/mid-cap stocks and broad/sector ETFs. Rides AI infrastructure and sector breakouts with trailing stops. Quality over speculation — no leveraged ETFs, no crypto, no penny stocks. CLAUDE.md rules govern: 7% risk/trade, 30% max position, 20% trailing stop.
rules: Enter on 2+ signals: breakout above multi-week high, momentum leader in hot sector, oversold snapback off support, or near-term catalyst.
Size by risk: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 30% of equity.
18-20% trailing stop on every entry. Never remove or widen stops.
Cut if position is down ~12% from entry and thesis is broken.
Time-stop after 2-3 weeks of dead money — recycle the capital.
No new entries on daily loss ≤ -8%. STAND DOWN on MTD ≤ -25%.
